peopleAlsoAsk.question: What do the viruses do after cell lysis?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Release. For naked viruses, the virus particles are released via cell lysis of the infected cells. Thus, no specific exit mechanism is necessary, because the cell membrane that traps the assembled virus particles are dismantled.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Can you freeze cells in 90% FBS?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The most common freezing medium is 90% FBS/10% DMSO. For less finicky cells and for tissue culture on a budget, 10% DMSO in cell growth medium can also be used. After centrifugation, resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of freezing medium per cryovial. Make sure you have cryovials designed for liquid N2 storage.
